title: Swap Seats
description: Swap seats with the person sitting directly opposite you.

title: High Five Everyone
description: Get up and give everyone in the room a high five.

title: Spin Again
description: You must immediately spin the wheel again.

title: Change the Music
description: You get to choose the next song playing in the background.

title: Give a Toast
description: Stand up and give a 30-second toast to the group.

title: Create a Rule
description: Make up a new rule for the game that everyone must follow.

title: Cancel a Rule
description: You can remove one custom rule currently in play.

title: Group Selfie
description: Organize a group selfie right now.

title: Left Hand Handshake
description: Shake everyone's hand using only your left hand.

title: Switch Drinks
description: Swap your beverage with someone else (if safe).

title: Play DJ
description: Change the song to something completely unexpected.

title: Mute the TV
description: If the TV is on, you must mute it for one round.

title: Pick a Number
description: Have someone pick a number 1-10. If you guess it, they spin.

title: Truth Question
description: Ask any player a Truth question. They must answer.

title: Dare Someone
description: Give a small dare to the person to your left.

title: Reverse Direction
description: The turn order reverses immediately.

title: Double Turn
description: You get to take a second turn immediately after this one.

title: Lose a Turn
description: Skip your next turn completely.

title: Pass the Buck
description: Choose someone else to spin the wheel for you.

title: Everyone Stands
description: Everyone must stand up. Last person to stand does 5 squats.

title: Everyone Sits
description: Everyone must sit on the floor. Last one down loses 10 points.

title: Count to 10
description: The group must count to 10. If two people say a number at the same time, restart.

title: Nickname Time
description: Give everyone a new nickname they must use for 3 rounds.

title: Simon Says
description: Play a quick 30-second round of Simon Says.

title: Thumbs Up
description: Keep your thumbs up for the next full round.

title: No Electronics
description: Everyone must put their phones face down on the table.

title: Switch Shirts
description: Swap a jacket or sweater with someone in the room.

title: Share a Secret
description: Share a mild secret with the group.

title: Stretch Break
description: Lead the group in a 30-second stretch.

title: Ghost Story
description: Tell a two-sentence scary story.
